source: Only independently collected production policy-v2 bundle bound to frozen candidate deliveries; no historical author QA body paths at runtime.
literal_resolution: Every declared CID resolves at its requested actual-format locator. Unicode whitespace normalization preserves digits, units and punctuation. A single XLSX cell is exact. Same DOCX row cells may concatenate with explicit part/node lineage.
error_ownership: Schema/ID/reference mechanics belong to record_contract; date role/raw/precision/window/profile and public URL scope to time_and_scope; actual literal quote and format/value-role locator plus target resolvability to citation_resolution; frozen inputs and actual native containers to protected_delivery. Separate observable obligations are reported explicitly, never counted as scientific proof.
padding: Fixed component/subcheck denominators use all-declared obligations; extra correct citations or records cannot dilute a retained bad graph or literal locator.
absence: No forced counts. Empty discovery and matters do not prove coverage; independent Judge assesses actual investigation and omissions. No content citation means zero actual citation-resolution credit.
candidate_defects: Malformed public schema, graph, URL, quote, date, supplied native container or protected input are candidate defects; not network failures.
unsupported_legal_locator: Typed NEEDS_LOCATOR_REVIEW or NEEDS_SOURCE_REVIEW; no global quote fallback or candidate zero.
semantic_requirements: actual autonomous discovery and reading from complete observable trace
statement to source relation and applicable context
date role and latest version semantics
bounded personal applicability and usable native handoff
